brief:
Settlers attacked the village of Burqa, located east of Ramallah, destroying a vehicle during the assault, Shehab Wire reported. The incident occurred in an area that has experienced repeated confrontations between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers in recent months.

The attack adds to a pattern of settler violence in the West Bank, where such incidents have intensified tensions between Palestinian communities and Israeli settlement outposts. Authorities have not yet released details about potential casualties or the circumstances surrounding the targeting of the vehicle.
